paper_metadata.title: The influence of aluminum content on the microstructure and mechanical properties of TiZrHfNbAlx refractory high entropy alloys
paper_metadata.journal: International Journal of Refractory Metals and Hard Materials

process_steps.input_state: raw materials Ti, Zr, Hf, Nb, Al (purities exceeding 99.9 wt%)

evidence.quote: The smelting procedure is carried out as follows: First, the smelting furnace is evacuated to establish a vacuum environment. Next, high-purity argon gas (99.99 % purity) is introduced into the furnace. The smelting process then begins. To ensure uniform composition, the ingot is remelted ten times with inversion, with each cycle lasting approximately three minutes under a current of approximately 550 A. After smelting is complete, the material is cooled to room temperature, and samples are taken, resulting in a 100 g button-shaped alloy ingot.
